status: PHASE-0 SCAFFOLD — proposed, NOT wired to live hooks
philosophy: Blinkers without ceilings. Choose a door; exactly that door's access opens and nothing else. Switch doors freely (exit + re-enter); never widen a door mid-work. Denial = wrong door for that action, not a curiosity gate. Default is never-stuck.
tier_reason: Encodes SSOT open-door-harness v01 §2 taxonomy + §7 ratified defaults. Path globs are a first-pass to be refined from Phase-2 nudge telemetry; not empirically calibrated.

sync.direction: repo SSOT is canonical; runtime reads this + the active-door marker

defaults.compose_rule: exit_and_reenter_only — doors NEVER union; two profiles in one job = two sequential doors (usually a baton between)
defaults.never_stuck: choosing nothing = research_read (read/think/search, no writes). Thinking is never blocked; only acting outside a chosen blast radius is.

spend_tiers.plan-once: opus-class — planning/judgment, <=1 invocation per job (routing class ceiling, NOT an effort ceiling)

git_write_levels.commit-local: git add/commit in the door's scope only; NO push
git_write_levels.push: UNIVERSAL RED on Mac — never allowed by any door (see universal_rules.git_push_on_mac)

doors.name: research_read
doors.notes: Never-stuck default. No write scope at all.

doors.name: agentsmini_build
doors.purpose: Build/iterate agent code in one bounded project.
doors.notes: <project_subtree> is bound at door-enter time to a single project root; read and write are the SAME subtree.

doors.name: central_handoff
doors.purpose: Write shared artefacts + baton/Vellum handoff (absorbs vellum_witness per SSOT C-2).
doors.notes: Ledger writes always co-occur with handoff, so no separate vellum_witness door.

doors.name: worktree_feature
doors.purpose: Feature work in an isolated worktree (from worktree-door.mdc).
doors.notes: <worktree_subtree> is bound at door-enter time to the active worktree path. This Phase-0 job itself ran under this door class.

doors.name: pipe_run
doors.purpose: Run the five-stage research pipe / capture.
doors.notes: net_mesh combines web+searxng+beast-read. SSOT D2 recommends deferring this door; encoded here as proposed for completeness of the 6-door set.

doors.name: config_harness
doors.purpose: Edit hooks/rules/harness — the sensitive door. Forces unlock->edit->re-bless->lock for rules.

split_permission.hooks_and_scripts: agent-enterable — edit ~/.cursor/hooks/** and hooks.json freely (already unlocked)
split_permission.rules_mdc: architect_bless_required — rule .mdc changes need Ewan's second key (unlock->edit->update-config-manifest.py->lock); agents MUST NOT self-rewrite rules that bind them

doors.notes: Ground truth: config-lock.sh locks only rules/*.mdc (uchg); hooks.json + hooks/* are already editable.

secrets_infisical.detail: No door opens /opt/amplified/secrets, Infisical, ~/.amplified/keys.env, or any credential material. Ulysses-locked (SSOT §2).

red_core_door_independent.rule: door-independent — no door ever opens the Red core
red_core_door_independent.detail: Destroy / Launder (yolo-ceilings Red core) are blocked regardless of active door.

git_push_on_mac.rule: UNIVERSAL RED on Mac regardless of door
git_push_on_mac.detail: Mac is read-only for git push (AGENTS.md 2026-06-17). Landing goes via Beast / Devin PR. No door grants push.

constitutional_gate.detail: constitutional-gate.mdc staged modes apply inside every door: pre_client (default) warns+logs and work completes; client_live hard-blocks until compliant. Doors bound WHERE you act; the seven rods bound WHAT you may do anywhere.
